Office of the Provost and Vice President for Academic Affairs

MEMORANDUM

TO: Deans, Department Chairs, Directors, Faculty & Budget Officers

FROM: Dr. Sharon Oliver-Whitehurst Sharon Oliver-Whitehurst
Divisional Budget Officer for Academic Affairs

DATE: January 15, 2026

RE: 2026 Summer Research Contracts Dates—External Grant Funding

This memorandum is provided to assist you in preparing the Faculty Summer Research 2026
contracts.

All faculty contracts must be submitted via EPAF and received in the approval queue of
Sharon Whitehurst or the Office of Sponsored Programs by Friday, February 27, 2026. See
the Academic Affairs Dashboard under the Human Resources Module for guidance on
preparing EPAFs.

Log in to Banner Websis to:
1. Request Contractual PINS—Workflow Module
2. Access EPAF—New Employee Self-Service (Timesheet) Module
3. Submit a Budget Code change to the existing PIN - Workflow Module

Contract dates are as follows:
Start Date: May 20, 2026 End Date: August 4, 2026

Total possible workdays: 52
• Three Holidays that contractual employees do not get paid
    o Memorial Day (Monday, May 25, 2026)
    o Juneteenth Day (Friday, June 19, 2026)
    o Independence Day (Friday, July 3, 2026)

Maximum Rates Allowed for Summer Calculations
• Summer 2026 Salary
    o 9.5-Month Faculty: [(Salary) x 0.263]
• Summer 2026 Daily Salary Rates
    o 9.5-Month Faculty: [(Salary) x 0.263]/52 days
• Summer 2026 Hourly Rates Calculation
    o 9.5-Month Faculty: [(Salary) x 0.263] / 52 days / 8 hours
